strategy.name: relative_momentum
strategy.schedule: first evaluation bar close then every 168 completed hours; no off-schedule signal changes

execution_policy: One shared USDT cash account. At most one tradeable target asset; sell previous assets first and wait for realized cash. Each order has at least one complete hour delay, previous-hour volume cap, IOC remainder cancellation and explicit min/lot. Dust remains owned. Re-evaluate exit/entry need each hour using the latest scheduled target; no fabricated atomic switches or same-open sell and buy. No topping up a tradeable target holding between switches. Entry exposure cap includes all residual inventory; weights may drift thereafter.
research_rationale: One fixed long-only relative-strength hypothesis, not a retuning of prior independent signals. A two-week lookback and weekly decision schedule reduce turnover and enable relative selection while absolute momentum permits cash. No parameter grid. The published momentum literature motivates a test, not profitability in these assets or on this venue.
fee_note: Current public base USDT taker 0.13 percent checked 2026-11-15; stress doubles it. Received-base buy fee and quote sell fee. Additional adverse execution costs remain 15/30 bp. Current-cost counterfactual, not historical fee tiers or account execution evidence.
rules_note: Quantity increments match the preserved current catalog used by triangular-v1; hypothetical 5-USDT minimum is more restrictive than its 0.5-USDT public minimum. Historical rules unknown. No fee or minimum relaxation after outcomes.
prior_observation: August-December 2025 single-asset signals have already been inspected. No relative-rotation return has been calculated before registration. This is another exploratory trial on seen discovery data, not independent evidence. January-October 2026 strategy and benchmark performance remains gated and uninspected. Old experiment outcomes remain unchanged.
network_budget: No new downloads; reuse only the three hash-pinned v2 histories after full raw reconstruction and exact daily reconciliation.
capital_note: 100 USDT and 25 percent total entry exposure are synthetic research assumptions, not personal capital or live permissions.
limitations: Three survivors chosen for existing accepted data; selection bias and source revision risk. Hourly conditional cost model, not a full execution simulator. No IRT history, historical rules, liquidation, calibrated depth, statistical confidence, paper acceptance or real orders. Full BTC benchmark can have different risk from the allocation-limited candidate.
selection: Single fixed candidate; every stage must pass unchanged under both costs before the next stage opens. No automatic threshold, window, universe or parameter search.
